hypothesis: The best previous remainder model combined query and context lengths, obscuring query-row costs. Using query size directly alongside attention tails and both rotary terms should explain more of the cross-attention residual while preserving self-attention scaling.

pcvs.name: query_elements
pcvs.rationale: Exposes query-row work directly, including output projection and attention row overhead.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * attn.heads * hidden_states.shape[1] * ((hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1]) % 16)
pcvs.name: attention_tail_elements
pcvs.rationale: Captures attention remainder work, which was absent from the previous candidate and matters especially for short cross-attention contexts.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] * attn.inner_dim if rotary_emb is not None else 0
pcvs.name: rotary_elements
pcvs.rationale: Captures additional elementwise work on the rotary path.

pcvs.name: uses_rotary
pcvs.rationale: Captures fixed rotary dispatch and allocation overhead.
